title: Demand-driven incremental living review computation
claim_boundary: Source-verified specification and granular execution playbook only; demand-driven memoized DAG evaluation and bisimulation equivalence proofs remain open implementation gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Fine-grained dependency graph nodes and content-addressed revision fingerprints across observations, deduplication clusters, screening criteria, studies and PRISMA counts
open_gates: Define DagNodeKey, NodeMemoEntry, and IncrementalUpdateReceipt contracts in crates/searchright-contracts/src/living.rs.
Implement IncrementalReviewDag with content-addressed early cutoff and selective criterion-amendment invalidation in crates/searchright-living/src/lib.rs.
Implement incremental cluster merge and affected-study recomputation in crates/searchright-dedup/src/lib.rs and crates/searchright-study/src/lib.rs.
Build multi-wave bisimulation equivalence test suite in crates/searchright-living and crates/searchright-prisma proving bit-for-bit identity between incremental updates and full replay.
assertions.permitted_claim: Scaffolding exists; behaviour is not claimed.
